code.role: reset entry (same in every 32 KB bank)
state dispatcher: JMP ($0013) into a JMP table at $8003…
per-frame scroll routine entry (→ $836F): builds a column or row when the camera crosses an 8-px boundary
code.method: trace + code reading; map sweeps verified 100% on natural stretches

code.role: column builder: metatile quarters via LDA ($19),Y with offsets $15-$18, pushed to the stack-page buffer
nametable upload: stack pointer set to the buffer, unrolled PLA / STA $2007, entered at a computed point for the length
copies a fixed 64-byte table ($8619) to the stack buffer every frame
bit-level graphics compositor (ROL/AND masks) writing tile bytes to the stack buffer
RAM-resident unrolled STA $2007 copy (code in RAM $0798…$07F2, step 6) — the main VRAM writer
CHR unpacker (copies from ROM with fill constants $0818D/$08189)

maps: found/maps/verified/*.png|json: maps built by the game's own scroll code, each with its tile-by-tile check against the game's nametable on natural scrolling
